# Tailgater Hater overlay installation

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Pry along the edge of the trim, remove two 10mm nuts from studs, and install a custom sticker overlay. [t1003]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Pry along the edge of the trim piece closest to the glass.
2. Remove the two 10mm nuts from the studs on the brake light assembly.
3. [Partial] Lay out all parts including the sticker and diffuser for inspection.
4. [Partial] Use needle nose pliers to compress and press out the first clip on the rear of the light assembly.
5. [Partial] Use needle nose pliers to compress and press out the second clip on the rear of the light assembly.
6. Wipe the brake light diffuser with rubbing alcohol to clean it.
7. [Partial] Place the white diffuser face down onto the back of the brake light.
8. Align the top left edge of the custom sticker with the top right edge of the light.
9. [Partial] Work the sticker downward from the middle toward the edges to avoid bubbles.
10. Apply black electrical tape over any exposed red edges visible on the overlay.
11. Place a strip of electrical tape across the top edge to block ambient light.
12. Bolt the brake light assembly back into position.
13. Hook up the electrical connection for the brake light.
14. Press hard at each clip location until you hear them pop back into place when reinstalling the plastic trim piece.

_Procedure reported by [t1003]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-3rd-brake-light-overlay.1334/>_

## Tools

- Plastic trim tools [t1003]
- Needle nose pliers [t1003]
- 10mm socket [t1003]

## Parts

- [Partial] Black electrical tape, optional [t1003]
- Custom sticker overlay [t1003]

## Tips & gotchas

- Lay out all pieces before starting to avoid losing the diffuser. [t1003]
- Press hard on clip locations when reinstalling the trim piece until a pop is heard. [t1003]
